mapper.select: SELECT NVL(total_discharge_count, 0) AS totalDischargeCount, NVL(total_discharge_compare, 0) AS totalDischargeCompare, NVL(discharged_count, 0) AS dischargedCount, NVL(discharged_compare, 0) AS dischargedCompare, NVL(not_discharged_count, 0) AS notDischargedCount, NVL(not_discharged_compare, 0) AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(settlement_amount, 0) AS settlementAmount, NVL(settlement_amount_compare, 0) AS settlementAmountCompare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT item_date AS itemDate, NVL(total_last, 0) AS totalLast, NVL(total_current, 0) AS totalCurrent, NVL(total_compare, 0) AS totalCompare, NVL(discharged_last, 0) AS dischargedLast, NVL(discharged_current, 0) AS dischargedCurrent, NVL(discharged_compare, 0) AS dischargedCompare, NVL(not_discharged_last, 0) AS notDischargedLast, NVL(not_discharged_current, 0) AS notDischargedCurrent, NVL(not_discharged_compare, 0) AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(amount_last, 0) AS amountLast, NVL(amount_current, 0) AS amountCurrent, NVL(amount_compare, 0) AS amountCompare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_DTL WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY item_date

SELECT totalDischargeCount, CASE WHEN lyTotalDischargeCount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((totalDischargeCount - lyTotalDischargeCount) / lyTotalDischargeCount * 100, 0) END AS totalDischargeCompare, dischargedCount, CASE WHEN lyDischargedCount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((dischargedCount - lyDischargedCount) / lyDischargedCount * 100, 0) END AS dischargedCompare, notDischargedCount, CASE WHEN lyNotDischargedCount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((notDischargedCount - lyNotDischargedCount) / lyNotDischargedCount * 100, 0) END AS notDischargedCompare, settlementAmount, CASE WHEN lySettlementAmount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((settlementAmount - lySettlementAmount) / lySettlementAmount * 100, 0) END AS settlementAmountCompare FROM ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN total_discharge_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalDischargeCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{startDate}, -12) AND ADD_MONTHS(#{endDate}, -12) THEN total_discharge_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lyTotalDischargeCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN discharged_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dischargedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{startDate}, -12) AND ADD_MONTHS(#{endDate}, -12) THEN discharged_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lyDischargedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN not_discharged_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS notDischargedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{startDate}, -12) AND ADD_MONTHS(#{endDate}, -12) THEN not_discharged_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lyNotDischargedCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} THEN settlement_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settlementAmount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN stat_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{startDate}, -12) AND ADD_MONTHS(#{endDate}, -12) THEN settlement_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lySettlementAmount FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN ADD_MONTHS(#{startDate}, -12) AND #{endDate} )

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "date", NVL(SUM(total_last), 0) AS totalLast, NVL(SUM(total_current), 0) AS totalCurrent, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(total_last), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(total_current) - SUM(total_last)) / SUM(total_last) * 100, 0) END AS totalCompare, NVL(SUM(discharged_last), 0) AS dischargedLast, NVL(SUM(discharged_current), 0) AS dischargedCurrent, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(discharged_last), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(discharged_current) - SUM(discharged_last)) / SUM(discharged_last) * 100, 0) END AS dischargedCompare, NVL(SUM(not_discharged_last), 0) AS notDischargedLast, NVL(SUM(not_discharged_current), 0) AS notDischargedCurrent, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(not_discharged_last), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(not_discharged_current) - SUM(not_discharged_last)) / SUM(not_discharged_last) * 100, 0) END AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(SUM(amount_last), 0) AS amountLast, NVL(SUM(amount_current), 0) AS amountCurrent, CASE WHEN NVL(SUM(amount_last), 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((SUM(amount_current) - SUM(amount_last)) / SUM(amount_last) * 100, 0) END AS amountCompare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_DTL WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM') ORDER BY TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM')

SELECT
TO_CHAR(TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') item_name AS name, NVL(SUM(item_value), 0) AS value, ROUND(NVL(AVG(item_compare), 0), 0) AS compare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_CHT WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND chart_type = #{chartType} GROUP BY
TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM') item_name
ORDER BY
TRUNC(stat_date, 'MM') item_name
